review_notes:
I read the whole target file and compared it with `exists_l1_fpf_F4` in L32A770k.lean and with the setup in L32AC38n.lean. I found no justified finding for this rubric.

The most visible repetition is the setup block in `mem_pCoreOf_l1_of_ψ_F4` and `Wt_eq_of_range_le_F4`. Both begin with `hMod`, `IsMulCommutative ↥V`, `obtain ⟨V₂, hV2⟩`, `S14` and `exists_l1_fpf_F4`. The same block also appears in L32AC38n, L32AC38k, L32AC43a and other files. It is only a chain of calls to existing API with no mathematical argument in it. A helper that bundles it would be a thin wrapper of the kind the rubric rules out, and it would also need `V₂` and `S14` packaged as an existential.

Inside `exists_T_comm_not_mem_F4` and `mem_pCoreOf_l1_of_ψ_F4`, the steps that move `g ^ n = 1` from a subtype `↥(nX T V)` or `↥H` into the image of `ρ` or `ψ` are one-line `Subtype.ext (by simpa ...)` and `map_pow` rewrites. They are short and routine, so they do not meet the bar. The two main proofs share no larger argument beyond that. The first builds a `ρ`-contradiction through `sl2_comm_ne`. The second uses a quotient-of-order-3 argument and a coprime-order argument.

The long repeated block in L32A770k.lean is the `Subgroup.mul_mem_iff_of_index_two` step, which appears three times with the same shape. It is outside the target file, so I did not report it.
